items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: we took lessons from him and after he'd taken sick, well he didn't give them no more

ctx.x: I was going to ask a little bit before we've only got a couple more minutes to start on here, but anything about your lessons you can remember that old man up is Jim Humphrey
and he said, yeah well, we took lessons from him and after he'd taken sick, well he didn't give them no more, we'd get around there and do it ourself, you see.
Remember anything like, did he have certain books or when he'd teach you alone, did he have a method book?
